name: 12 Hours of Sunlight
description: 21k feet in 11 hours (13 laps). One more lap would have tied the laps for first and clinched the podium (third) and was very doable (had a whole hour and my splits were still under an hour) but I was worried my foot might have a stress fracture so I didn’t go for it. No stress fracture it’s totally fine I was just overreacting. I hit every goal I had for this day going in though so this is a major win!
